commitResults.messageTitle: Create Task class to manage task statuses
Add Deadline task, Event task and Todo task
Add ability to save the list
Switch date and time representation from String to LocalDateTime
refactor: extract user interaction into Ui
commitResults.messageBody:
Move Kotha's welcome, command input, task-list display, task-count, goodbye, and error-output responsibilities into a dedicated Ui class. Keep command dispatch and task mutation in Kotha so this remains a small, behavior-preserving refactoring step.

Also normalize the source package declarations to kotha so the classes share one package and can be imported as kotha.Kotha.
Store the backing path per Storage instance and configure Kotha with data/kotha.txt. Handle storage files without a parent directory so the class remains reusable for tests and alternate locations.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract command classification into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Move command-word recognition out of Kotha into Parser.CommandType while retaining argument validation and command execution in Kotha. Preserve existing command behavior and unknown-command handling.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract task collection into TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce TaskList to own task storage and basic collection operations. Update Kotha to load, display, mutate, and persist tasks through TaskList while preserving existing command behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract task mutations into TaskOperations
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce a task-operation class for adding, removing, marking, and unmarking tasks. Keep command validation and coordination in Kotha while delegating state mutations to the new class.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: move task commands into TaskOperations
commitResults.messageBody: Move todo, deadline, event, delete, mark, and unmark command operations out of Kotha. TaskOperations now validates command arguments, creates and mutates tasks, reports task changes, and persists the updated list.

Replace the TaskOperations-specific exception with a package-level KothaException that can be used by Kotha and all other classes in the kotha package. Preserve the existing user-facing error messages and checked-exception flow.

commitResults.messageTitle: Change error messages to better fit Kotha's personality
Edit JavaDoc comments in Parser.java and Ui.java
refactor: move task behavior into domain classes
commitResults.messageBody:
Apply SE-EDU Java coding conventions across the task classes, correct TaskList.remove to return the removed task, and use PECS for task collection inputs and consumers.

Remove TaskOperations. Task now creates validated ToDo, Deadline, and Event instances and owns completion-state behavior, while TaskList owns collection mutations. Kotha remains responsible for command coordination, UI interaction, and persistence.
